6143void UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::ShowUnitInspection()
6144{
6145 if (mUIModel == nullptr)
6146 {
6147 return;
6148 }
6149 const FUnitDetailUI& Detail = mUIModel->GetUnitDetail();
6150 if (Detail.mUnitId == INDEX_NONE)
6151 {
6152 return;
6153 }
6154 const FUnitUI* Unit = nullptr;
6155 int32 EnemyRow = INDEX_NONE;
6156 int32 AliveEnemyCount = 0;
6157 for (const FUnitUI& Candidate : mUIModel->GetUnitUIs())
6158 {
6159 const bool bAliveEnemy = Candidate.mIsPlayer == false && Candidate.mHP > 0.f;
6160 if (Candidate.mUnitId == Detail.mUnitId)
6161 {
6162 Unit = &Candidate;
6163 if (bAliveEnemy == true)
6164 {
6165 EnemyRow = AliveEnemyCount;
6166 }
6167 }
6168 if (bAliveEnemy == true)
6169 {
6170 ++AliveEnemyCount;
6171 }
6172 }
6173 if (Unit == nullptr || Unit->mIsPlayer == true)
6174 {
6175 return;
6176 }
6177 if (mMonsterTabWidgetClass == nullptr)
6178 {
6179 ShowUnitDetailOverlay();
6180 return;
6181 }
6182 if (EnemyRow != INDEX_NONE)
6183 {
6184 mMonsterTabSelectedRow = EnemyRow;
6185 mMonsterTabInspectedUnitId = Detail.mUnitId;
6186 }
6187 SetMonsterTabShown(true);
6188}
6189
6190void UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::ShowUnitDetailOverlay()
6191{
6192 if (mUIModel == nullptr || EnsureDetailOverlayWidget() == false)
6193 {
6194 return;
6195 }
6196 const FUnitDetailUI& Detail = mUIModel->GetUnitDetail();
6197 if (Detail.mUnitId == INDEX_NONE)
6198 {
6199 return;
6200 }
6201 ApplyReadableDetailTypography(false);
6202 ApplyDetailColumnLayout(false);
6203
6204 SetTextIfPresent(mDetailTitleText, Detail.mName);
6205
6206 const FUnitUI* Unit = nullptr;
6207 for (const FUnitUI& Candidate : mUIModel->GetUnitUIs())
6208 {
6209 if (Candidate.mUnitId == Detail.mUnitId)
6210 {
6211 Unit = &Candidate;
6212 break;
6213 }
6214 }
6215
6216 FText Subtitle = FText::Format(LOCTEXT("UnitDetailLevel", "Lv.{0}"),
6217 FMath::Max(1, Detail.mLevel));
6218 if (Unit != nullptr)
6219 {
6220 const FText Side = Unit->mIsPlayer == true
6221 ? LOCTEXT("UnitDetailAlly", "아군")
6222 : LOCTEXT("UnitDetailEnemy", "적");
6223 Subtitle = FText::Format(
6224 LOCTEXT("UnitDetailIdentityAndHp", "{0} · {1} · HP {2}/{3}"),
6225 Subtitle, Side, FMath::RoundToInt(Unit->mHP),
6226 FMath::RoundToInt(Unit->mMaxHP));
6227 if (Unit->mDefensePoint > 0.f)
6228 {
6229 Subtitle = FText::Format(
6230 LOCTEXT("UnitDetailWithDefense", "{0} · 방어 {1}"), Subtitle,
6231 FMath::RoundToInt(Unit->mDefensePoint));
6232 }
6233 }
6234 SetTextIfPresent(mDetailSubtitleText, Subtitle);
6235
6236 // 소켓에는 이 유닛의 초상을 건다. 안 걸면 직전 스킬 아이콘이 그대로 남는다
6237 // (0806 검수: 적 상세에 칼 아이콘이 떠 있었다).
6238 if (Unit != nullptr)
6239 {
6240 UTexture2D* Portrait = Unit->mTurnPortrait != nullptr
6241 ? Unit->mTurnPortrait.Get() : Unit->mPortrait.Get();
6242 if (Portrait != nullptr)
6243 {
6244 SetPortraitCropped(mDetailIconImage, Portrait);
6245 }
6246 }
6247
6248 // 유닛에는 조준/타격 형태가 없다. 스킬 상세가 칠해 둔 칸을 걷고, 칩은 유닛
6249 // 스탯으로 갈아 끼운다 -- 스킬 값이 남아 있으면 다른 대상 수치로 읽힌다.
6250 ClearDetailGrids();
6251 ClearDetailChips();
6252 SetDetailChip(0, LOCTEXT("DetailChipLevel", "레벨"), FText::AsNumber(Detail.mLevel));
6253 if (Unit != nullptr)
6254 {
6255 SetDetailChip(1, LOCTEXT("DetailChipHp", "HP"), FText::FromString(
6256 FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f/%.0f"), Unit->mHP, Unit->mMaxHP)));
6257 SetDetailChip(2, LOCTEXT("DetailChipDefense", "방어"),
6258 FText::AsNumber(FMath::RoundToInt(Unit->mDefensePoint)));
6259 SetDetailChip(3, LOCTEXT("DetailChipSpeed", "속도"),
6260 FText::AsNumber(FMath::RoundToInt(Unit->mSpeedPoint)));
6261 SetDetailChip(4, LOCTEXT("DetailChipAp", "AP"), FText::AsNumber(Unit->mActionPoints));
6262 SetDetailChip(5, LOCTEXT("UnitDetailChipCritical", "치명타"), FText::AsNumber(FMath::RoundToInt(Unit->mCriticalPoint)));
6263 }
6264
6265 TArray<FText> PassiveLines;
6266 for (const FText& Passive : Detail.mPassiveDescriptions)
6267 {
6268 PassiveLines.Add(FText::Format(
6269 LOCTEXT("UnitDetailPassiveLine", "· {0}"), Passive));
6270 }
6271 FText Body = PassiveLines.IsEmpty()
6272 ? LOCTEXT("UnitDetailNoPassives", "패시브 없음")
6273 : FText::Join(FText::FromString(TEXT("\n")), PassiveLines);
6274 if (Unit != nullptr && Unit->mIsPlayer == false)
6275 {
6276 // 판에 함께 칠린 위협 범위의 범례다. 칠만 있고 뜻을 알려 주는 곳이
6277 // 없으면 밴드와 채움을 구분할 길이 없다.
6278 Body = FText::Format(LOCTEXT("UnitDetailEnemyThreatLegend",
6279 "{0}\n\n판의 표시는 이 적이 한 턴에 닿는 곳이다.\n테두리 밴드 = 이동 범위, 채움 = 공격 범위."), Body);
6280 }
6281 SetTextIfPresent(mDetailBodyText, Body);
6282
6283 SetPortraitCropped(mDetailIconImage, Detail.mPortrait);
6284 SetShown(mDetailStatBlock, true);
6285 ShowDetailRightBlock(mDetailSkillBlock);
6286 RefreshDetailSkillRow();
6287 // 자기는 눌림을 안 받고 스킬 칸만 받는다. 그래서 칸 밖을 톡 치면 눌림이
6288 // HUD 까지 내려가 패널이 닫힌다.
6289 mDetailOverlayWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
6290 RefreshWorldGestureInputBlock();
6291}

6351void UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::ClearDetailChips()
6352{

6367bool UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::StartSkillWorldPreview()
6368{
6369 // 미리보기 이미지 위젯은 프레젠터가 짓는다. 겹이 아직 없으면 그냥 실패한다.
6370 if (mDetailPresenter != nullptr)
6371 {
6372 mDetailPresenter->EnsureSkillVisualPreviewBuilt();
6373 mSkillWorldPreviewImage = mDetailPresenter->GetWorldPreviewImage();
6374 }
6375 UWorld* World = GetWorld();
6376 if (World == nullptr || mSkillWorldPreviewImage == nullptr)
6377 {
6378 return false;
6379 }
6380
6381 UCameraComponent* SourceCamera = nullptr;
6382 if (ACombatCameraPawn* MainCamera = UCameraFunctionLibrary::GetMainCameraPawn(this))
6383 {
6384 SourceCamera = MainCamera->GetCameraComponent();
6385 }
6386 if (SourceCamera == nullptr)
6387 {
6388 // 편집기 자동 캡처처럼 PlayerController가 아직 Pawn을 소유하기 전에도
6389 // 실제 카메라 액터가 있으면 같은 경로를 검수할 수 있게 한다.
6390 for (TActorIterator<ACameraActor> It(World); It; ++It)
6391 {
6392 SourceCamera = It->GetCameraComponent();
6393 break;
6394 }
6395 }
6396 if (SourceCamera == nullptr)
6397 {
6398 return false;
6399 }
6400 mSkillWorldPreviewSourceCamera = SourceCamera;
6401
6402 if (mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget == nullptr)
6403 {
6404 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget = NewObject<UTextureRenderTarget2D>(this,
6405 TEXT("SkillDetailWorldRenderTarget"), RF_Transient);
6406 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget->RenderTargetFormat = RTF_RGBA8_SRGB;
6407 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget->ClearColor = FLinearColor(0.008f, 0.01f, 0.015f, 1.f);
6408 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget->InitCustomFormat(1024, 384, PF_B8G8R8A8, true);
6409 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget->UpdateResourceImmediate(true);
6410 }
6411 if (mSkillWorldPreviewCapture == nullptr)
6412 {
6413 FActorSpawnParameters Params;
6414 Params.Name = MakeUniqueObjectName(World, ASceneCapture2D::StaticClass(),
6415 TEXT("SkillDetailSceneCapture"));
6416 Params.ObjectFlags |= RF_Transient;
6417 Params.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AlwaysSpawn;
6418 mSkillWorldPreviewCapture = World->SpawnActor<ASceneCapture2D>(Params);
6419 }
6420 USceneCaptureComponent2D* CaptureComponent = mSkillWorldPreviewCapture != nullptr
6421 ? mSkillWorldPreviewCapture->GetCaptureComponent2D() : nullptr;
6422 if (CaptureComponent == nullptr)
6423 {
6424 return false;
6425 }
6426 CaptureComponent->TextureTarget = mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget;
6427 CaptureComponent->CaptureSource = ESceneCaptureSource::SCS_FinalColorLDR;
6428 CaptureComponent->bCaptureEveryFrame = true;
6429 CaptureComponent->bCaptureOnMovement = true;
6430 CaptureComponent->bAlwaysPersistRenderingState = true;
6431 CaptureComponent->ShowFlags.SetMotionBlur(false);
6432
6433 FSlateBrush Brush;
6434 Brush.SetResourceObject(mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget);
6435 Brush.ImageSize = FVector2D(1024.f, 384.f);
6436 Brush.DrawAs = ESlateBrushDrawType::Image;
6437 mSkillWorldPreviewImage->SetBrush(Brush);
6438 mSkillWorldPreviewImage->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
6439 mSkillWorldPreviewActive = true;
6440 SyncSkillWorldPreviewCamera(true);
6441 return true;
6442}
6443
6444void UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::SyncSkillWorldPreviewCamera(const bool bCaptureImmediately)
6445{
6446 if (mSkillWorldPreviewCapture == nullptr || mSkillWorldPreviewSourceCamera == nullptr)
6447 {
6448 StopSkillWorldPreview();
6449 return;
6450 }
6451 UCameraComponent* Source = mSkillWorldPreviewSourceCamera;
6452 USceneCaptureComponent2D* Capture = mSkillWorldPreviewCapture->GetCaptureComponent2D();
6453 if (Source == nullptr || Capture == nullptr)
6454 {
6455 StopSkillWorldPreview();
6456 return;
6457 }
6458 mSkillWorldPreviewCapture->SetActorTransform(Source->GetComponentTransform());
6459 Capture->ProjectionType = Source->ProjectionMode;
6460 Capture->FOVAngle = Source->FieldOfView;
6461 // 패널이 본 화면보다 가로로 길다. 같은 폭을 쓰면 전장이 지나치게 작아지므로
6462 // 실제 카메라 중심은 유지하고 약간만 줌인한다.
6463 Capture->OrthoWidth = Source->OrthoWidth * 0.78f;
6464 Capture->PostProcessSettings = Source->PostProcessSettings;
6465 Capture->PostProcessBlendWeight = Source->PostProcessBlendWeight;
6466 if (bCaptureImmediately)
6467 {
6468 Capture->CaptureScene();
6469 }
6470}

6472void UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::StopSkillWorldPreview()
6473{
6474 mSkillWorldPreviewActive = false;
6475 if (mSkillWorldPreviewCapture != nullptr
6476 && mSkillWorldPreviewCapture->GetCaptureComponent2D() != nullptr)
6477 {
6478 mSkillWorldPreviewCapture->GetCaptureComponent2D()->bCaptureEveryFrame = false;
6479 }
6480 SetShown(mSkillWorldPreviewImage, false);
6481}

6483void UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::ReleaseSkillWorldPreview()
6484{
6485 StopSkillWorldPreview();
6486 if (mSkillWorldPreviewCapture != nullptr)

6489 }
6490 mSkillWorldPreviewCapture = nullptr;
6491 mSkillWorldPreviewSourceCamera = nullptr;
6492 if (mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget != nullptr)
6493 {
6494 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget->ReleaseResource();
6495 }
6496 mSkillWorldPreviewRenderTarget = nullptr;
6497 mSkillWorldPreviewImage = nullptr;
6498}

6502{

6504 {

6508 if (Detail.mSkillIndex == INDEX_NONE)
6509 {
6510 return;

6518 // 데이터 생산자가 스킬 index만 채운 경우, 이미 받은 전투 카드 View의
6519 // 같은 슬롯에서 표시 식별 정보만 보완한다. 모델은 다시 조회하지 않는다.
6520 FSkillDetailUI Fallback = Detail;
6521 const FSkillUI* Skill = mUIModel->GetSkillUIs().FindByPredicate(
6522 [&Detail](const FSkillUI& Candidate)
6523 {

6526 if (Skill != nullptr
6527 && SkillDetailUIBuilder::FillFallbackFromCombatSkillView(
6528 *Skill, OUT Fallback))
6529 {
6530 ShowSkillDetailOverlay(Fallback);
6531 }

6646#undef LOCTEXT_NAMESPACE
6647
6648UWidget* UCombatLayoutHUDWidget::ResolveGuidedTarget(EGuidedStage S, EGuidedStage& Next, bool& Board, bool& Retry)
6649{
6650 Next=S;Board=false;Retry=false;
6651 if(!mUIModel)return nullptr;
6652 const auto Phase=mUIModel->GetTurnUI().mPhase;
6653 const auto Pending=mUIModel->GetPendingAction().mType;
6654 const bool Detail=IsDetailOverlayShown();
6655 auto Named=[this](const TCHAR* Name)->UWidget*{return GetWidgetFromName(Name);};
6656 auto Command=[this](int32 I)->UWidget*{return mCommandSlots.IsValidIndex(I)?mCommandSlots[I].Button.Get():nullptr;};
6657 const auto* Tutorial = GetGameInstance() ? GetGameInstance()->GetSubsystem<UFirstPlayTutorialSubsystem>() : nullptr;
6658 const int32 FixedSkill = Tutorial && Tutorial->IsScenarioGuiding() ? Tutorial->GetScenarioSkillIndex() : INDEX_NONE;
6659 auto SkillIndex=[this, FixedSkill]()->int32{if(FixedSkill!=INDEX_NONE)return FixedSkill+1;const auto& Skills=mUIModel->GetSkillUIs();for(int32 I=0;I<Skills.Num();++I)if(Skills[I].mIsUsable)return I+1;return INDEX_NONE;};
6660 auto Advance=[&](){Next=FGuidedTutorialProgress::NextStage(S);};
6661 // A long press on the instructed move/attack card may open its details instead of selecting it.
6662 // Keep a close target available so forced guidance never traps the player behind that modal.
6663 if (Detail && (S == EGuidedStage::SelectMove || S == EGuidedStage::SelectSkill))
6664 {
6665 Retry = true;
6666 return mDetailOverlayWidget->GetWidgetFromName(TEXT("DetailCloseButton"));
6667 }
6668 switch(S){
6669 case EGuidedStage::ReadTurnOrder:return Named(TEXT("TurnPanel"));
6670 case EGuidedStage::ReadPlaybackSpeed:return mPlaybackWidget ? mPlaybackWidget->GetSpeedButton() : nullptr;
6671 case EGuidedStage::ReadAP:return mTurnAPRoot;
6672 case EGuidedStage::ReadStatus:return Named(TEXT("AllyPanel"));
6673 case EGuidedStage::ReadCondition:return Named(TEXT("AllyCondition"));
6674 case EGuidedStage::ReadMercenaryStats:return mMercenaryDetailHP;
6675 case EGuidedStage::ReadInventory:return mMercenaryInventoryPage;
6676 case EGuidedStage::ReadEnemy:return mMonsterTabWidget?mMonsterTabWidget->GetWidgetFromName(TEXT("MonsterDetailHPText")):nullptr;
6677 case EGuidedStage::ReadSkillCost:case EGuidedStage::ReadSkillCooldown:
6678 case EGuidedStage::SelectRange:case EGuidedStage::EffectRange:case EGuidedStage::ReadEnemySkill:
6679 if(!Detail) return nullptr;
6680 return mDetailPresenter ? mDetailPresenter->GetGuidedSystemTarget(S) : nullptr;
6681 case EGuidedStage::OpenSkills:
6682 if(mCommandsShown){Advance();return nullptr;}return Named(TEXT("SkillToggleButton"));
6683 case EGuidedStage::HoldSkill:
6684 if(Detail){Advance();return nullptr;}
6685 if(IsAiming()){Retry=true;return Named(TEXT("CancelButton"));}
6686 if(!mCommandsShown)return Named(TEXT("SkillToggleButton"));
6687 return Command(FixedSkill != INDEX_NONE ? FixedSkill + 1 : (mUIModel->GetSkillUIs().Num()>0?1:INDEX_NONE));
6688 case EGuidedStage::CloseSkill:case EGuidedStage::CloseMercenarySkill:case EGuidedStage::CloseMonsterSkill:case EGuidedStage::CloseArtifact:
6689 if(!Detail){Advance();return nullptr;}return mDetailOverlayWidget->GetWidgetFromName(TEXT("DetailCloseButton"));
6690 case EGuidedStage::SelectMove:
6691 if(const auto* U=FindTurnUnit(); !U || !U->mCanMove || U->mMovementPoint<1)return Named(TEXT("EndTurnButton"));
6692 if(Pending==ECombatPendingActionType::Move && Phase!=ECombatBuildPhaseUI::None){Advance();return nullptr;}
6693 if(!mCommandsShown)return Named(TEXT("SkillToggleButton"));return Command(0);
6694 case EGuidedStage::MoveTile:
6695 if(Pending!=ECombatPendingActionType::Move){Next=EGuidedStage::SelectMove;return nullptr;}
6696 if(Phase==ECombatBuildPhaseUI::Preview){Advance();return nullptr;}Board=true;return nullptr;
6697 case EGuidedStage::ConfirmMove:
6698 if(Pending!=ECombatPendingActionType::Move){Next=EGuidedStage::SelectMove;return nullptr;}
6699 if(Phase!=ECombatBuildPhaseUI::Preview){Next=EGuidedStage::MoveTile;return nullptr;}return mConfirmButton;
6700 case EGuidedStage::SelectSkill:
6701 if(SkillIndex()==INDEX_NONE)return Named(TEXT("EndTurnButton"));
6702 if(Pending==ECombatPendingActionType::Skill && Phase!=ECombatBuildPhaseUI::None){Advance();return nullptr;}
6703 if(!mCommandsShown)return Named(TEXT("SkillToggleButton"));return Command(SkillIndex());
6704 case EGuidedStage::SkillTarget:
6705 if(Pending!=ECombatPendingActionType::Skill){Next=EGuidedStage::SelectSkill;return nullptr;}
6706 if(Phase==ECombatBuildPhaseUI::Preview){Advance();return nullptr;}Board=true;return nullptr;
6707 case EGuidedStage::ConfirmSkill:
6708 if(Pending!=ECombatPendingActionType::Skill){Next=EGuidedStage::SelectSkill;return nullptr;}
6709 if(Phase!=ECombatBuildPhaseUI::Preview){Next=EGuidedStage::SkillTarget;return nullptr;}return mConfirmButton;
6710 case EGuidedStage::EndTurn:return Named(TEXT("EndTurnButton"));
6711 case EGuidedStage::OpenMercenary:
6712 if(IsMercenaryPanelShown()){Advance();return nullptr;}return Named(TEXT("MenuButton_1"));
6713 case EGuidedStage::SelectMercenary:return Named(TEXT("PartyButton_0"));
6714 case EGuidedStage::MercenarySkill:
6715 if(Detail){Advance();return nullptr;}return Named(TEXT("MercenarySkillButton_1"));
6716 case EGuidedStage::OpenInventory:
6717 if(mMercenaryInventoryShown){Advance();return nullptr;}return mMercenaryInventoryButton;
6718 case EGuidedStage::Artifact:
6719 if(mUIModel->GetPlayerMeta().mArtifacts.IsEmpty()){Next=EGuidedStage::CloseMercenary;return nullptr;}
6720 if(Detail){Advance();return nullptr;}return mMercenaryInventoryArtifactButtons.IsValidIndex(0)?mMercenaryInventoryArtifactButtons[0].Get():nullptr;
6721 case EGuidedStage::CloseMercenary:return mMercenaryCloseButton;
6722 case EGuidedStage::OpenMonster:
6723 if(IsMonsterTabShown()){Advance();return nullptr;}
6724 if(!mUIModel->GetUnitUIs().ContainsByPredicate([](const FUnitUI& U){return !U.mIsPlayer && U.mHP>0;})){return nullptr;}
6725 return Named(TEXT("MenuButton_2"));
6726 case EGuidedStage::SelectMonster:return mMonsterTabWidget?mMonsterTabWidget->GetWidgetFromName(TEXT("MonsterRowButton_0")):nullptr;
6727 case EGuidedStage::HoldMonsterSkill:
6728 if(Detail){Advance();return nullptr;}
6729 if(mMonsterTabWidget)for(int32 I=0;I<mMonsterTabSkillIndices.Num();++I)if(mMonsterTabSkillIndices[I]!=INDEX_NONE)return mMonsterTabWidget->GetWidgetFromName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MonsterSkillButton_%d"),I));
6730 Next=EGuidedStage::CloseMonster;return nullptr;
6731 case EGuidedStage::CloseMonster:return mMonsterTabWidget?mMonsterTabWidget->GetWidgetFromName(TEXT("MonsterBackButton")):nullptr;
6732 default:return nullptr;
6733 }
6734}
